Initial term ends February 23, 2027 and auto-renews for 12-month periods unless either side gives 90 days' notice. Company non-renewal is treated as termination without cause and triggers 6 months' severance plus COBRA.

HR/Contracts/US/OConnor_Daniel_Executive.termination_terms: For cause anytime; without cause on 30 days' notice. Company non-renewal = termination without cause → severance.

Scans/scan_0042.pdf.title: Befristeter Arbeitsvertrag (Fixed-term employment contract)
Scans/scan_0042.pdf.summary: German fixed-term contract (no objective reason, § 14(2) TzBfG) for Lukas Becker as Senior Hardware Engineer in Berlin, January 1, 2025 – December 31, 2026. The two-year statutory maximum is already used, so it cannot be extended again on a fixed-term basis.
Scans/scan_0042.pdf.renewal_terms: Extension only within the 2-year statutory maximum (§ 14(2) TzBfG) — already reached.
Scans/scan_0042.pdf.notice_terms: Ends automatically at term; ordinary termination possible with statutory notice (§ 622 BGB); termination must be in wet-ink written form (§ 623 BGB).
Scans/scan_0042.pdf.non_compete: 12 months post-contractual; compensation 50% of last remuneration (§ 74 HGB).
Scans/scan_0042.pdf.termination_terms: Statutory notice (§ 622 BGB); written form mandatory (§ 623 BGB).

key_dates.label: Fixed term ends (no further fixed-term extension possible)

key_clauses.heading: § 1 Beginn und Befristung
key_clauses.original_text: Es ist gemäß § 14 Abs. 2 TzBfG ohne sachlichen Grund befristet und endet mit Ablauf des 31. Dezember 2026, ohne dass es einer Kündigung bedarf.
key_clauses.english_text: It is fixed-term without objective reason under § 14(2) TzBfG and ends at the close of December 31, 2026 without the need for notice.

key_clauses.heading: § 6 Kündigung
key_clauses.original_text: Jede Kündigung bedarf der Schriftform (§ 623 BGB); die elektronische Form ist ausgeschlossen.
key_clauses.english_text: Any termination must be in written form (§ 623 BGB); electronic form is excluded.

key_clauses.heading: § 7 Nachvertragliches Wettbewerbsverbot
key_clauses.original_text: …für die Dauer von zwölf Monaten… Karenzentschädigung in Höhe von 50 %…
key_clauses.english_text: …for twelve months… compensation of 50% of the last contractual remuneration…

risk_flags.title: Statutory maximum for fixed-term reached
risk_flags.detail: Two years without objective reason is the § 14(2) TzBfG maximum; another fixed-term extension would be invalid and create an indefinite contract.

risk_flags.title: Continued work after end date = indefinite contract
risk_flags.detail: If Lukas keeps working after the end date with the employer's knowledge, the contract becomes indefinite by law (§ 15(6) TzBfG).

risk_flags.title: Costly post-contractual non-compete
risk_flags.detail: The 12-month non-compete obliges ~€39,000 compensation unless waived in writing before the employment ends (§ 75a HGB).

Scans/scan_0042.pdf.recommendation_rationale: Senior hardware engineer in a critical role; the fixed-term route is exhausted. Convert to indefinite employment (the EMEA hiring freeze exempts retention of critical engineering roles), or let it end and waive the non-compete in writing to avoid ~€39k compensation.

HR/Contracts/EMEA/Contrato_Martinez_Sofi.title: Contrato de trabajo de duración determinada (Fixed-term employment contract)
HR/Contracts/EMEA/Contrato_Martinez_Sofi.summary: Spanish fixed-term contract 'por circunstancias de la producción' for Sofía Martínez, Marketing Manager in Madrid, for 18 months (August 29, 2025 – February 28, 2027) at €52,000 in 14 payments. 15 days' notice of expiry; 12 days' salary per year on expiry.

key_clauses.heading: SEGUNDA.– Modalidad y duración
key_clauses.original_text: …por circunstancias de la producción, al amparo del artículo 15.2 del Estatuto de los Trabajadores… Tendrá una duración de dieciocho (18) meses…
key_clauses.english_text: …for production circumstances under article 15.2 of the Workers' Statute… for a duration of eighteen (18) months…

key_clauses.heading: SEXTA.– Extinción

key_clauses.english_text: …must notify the other party at least fifteen (15) days in advance…

risk_flags.title: Term exceeds legal maximum for this contract type
risk_flags.detail: Since the 2022 labour reform, art. 15.2 ET contracts may last up to 6 months (12 if the collective agreement allows). An 18-month term risks the contract being deemed indefinite (fijo).

HR/Contracts/EMEA/Contrato_Martinez_Sofi.recommendation_rationale: The contract is likely already treated as indefinite; letting it 'expire' risks an unfair-dismissal claim. Regularise by converting to an indefinite contract (or take local advice before any exit).

key_dates.label: CDD ends — renewal avenant must be signed before this date

key_clauses.heading: Article 2 – Durée
key_clauses.original_text: Il pourra être renouvelé deux fois par avenant signé avant son terme, sans que la durée totale… ne dépasse dix-huit (18) mois.
key_clauses.english_text: It may be renewed twice by an amendment signed before its term, with a total duration not exceeding eighteen (18) months.

key_clauses.original_text: …une indemnité de fin de contrat égale à 10 % de la rémunération totale brute perçue…

risk_flags.title: CDD not signed by the employee
risk_flags.detail: A CDD without the employee's signature can be requalified as a permanent contract (CDI) by French courts. Obtain a signed copy or regularise now.

HR/Contracts/EMEA/CDD_Dubois_Camille.pdf.recommendation_rationale: Fix the missing signature first; then decide between a renewal avenant (max 18 months total) and conversion to CDI, which also avoids the 10% allowance.

HR/Contracts/US/Johnson_Emily_Employment.summary: At-will employment of Emily Johnson as Director of People Operations in Palo Alto since March 19, 2024 at $198,000. Contains a 12-month nationwide non-compete, which is void under California law.

key_clauses.heading: 4. Non-Competition
key_clauses.original_text: For a period of twelve (12) months following the termination of employment… shall not… engage in or be employed by any business that competes with the Company anywhere in the United States.
key_clauses.english_text: For a period of twelve (12) months following the termination of employment… shall not… engage in or be employed by any business that competes with the Company anywhere in the United States.

risk_flags.title: Void non-compete still in a California contract
risk_flags.detail: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §16600 voids employee non-competes, and §16600.1 required employers to notify affected employees that such clauses are void (deadline Feb 14, 2024). Keeping or enforcing it exposes the company to a private right of action and attorney's fees.

HR/Contracts/US/Johnson_Emily_Employment.recommendation_rationale: Amend to remove the non-compete (keep confidentiality and non-solicit of employees narrowly drawn) and send the §16600.1 notice now.
